why_not_armed: Thresholds must be derived from measured same-commit repeat variability, per docs/P1_PREREGISTRATION.md.
Those repeats are blocked on the OpenAI requests-per-day quota (10,000/day; one full run costs ~5,200 requests).
Until the variance table exists, every threshold below is null. A gate with an invented threshold is worse than no gate: it manufactures confidence.
threshold_formula_source: docs/P1_PREREGISTRATION.md, fixed before any repeat ran

superseded.previous_policy: eval score drop > 5%, latency increase > 15%, cost increase > 15%
superseded.why_superseded: Those numbers were chosen by judgement, not measured. The two P0 full runs differed by 34 pass/fail flips under an identical recorded configuration, so a 5% accuracy threshold was never anchored to anything observed.

gate.description: Fails CI when exceeded. Only metrics whose same-commit variability has been measured may be armed here.

task_success_rate.definition: SUCCESS episodes / episodes measured, single-database execution accuracy

consistency_pass_pow_k.definition: Share of tasks passing in every repeat of a run set
consistency_pass_pow_k.note: Requires k repeats per side; cannot be evaluated from a single run.

mean_model_turns_per_success.definition: Model API calls per successful episode

tool_validity_rate.definition: 1 - (tool calls with arguments not matching the declared schema / tool calls)

estimated_cost_per_success.definition: Total estimated cost / successful episodes, from token counts and the pricing snapshot
estimated_cost_per_success.note: Token-derived, not billed. Insulated from provider latency, unlike wall-clock cost proxies.

monitor.description: Reported on every run, never fails CI.

external_api_p95_latency_ms.why_monitor_only: Dominated by provider-side variation this project does not control. Measured directly: a 5-token call ranged 0.5s to 18s within one hour, and the cause was the SDK silently retrying 429s. Gating on it would fail CI for someone else's incident.

termination_reason_distribution.why_monitor_only: The taxonomy is not yet stable enough to gate. Two runs of an identical recorded configuration produced 49 termination-reason changes, of which 15 were fail-to-fail (e.g. VERIFICATION_FAILED to MAX_STEPS). Gating on a distribution that churns without any outcome changing would fire on noise.
termination_reason_distribution.promotion_criterion: Promote to gate once same-commit repeats show its fail-to-fail churn is small relative to the effect sizes worth catching.

episode_wall_clock_latency_ms.why_monitor_only: Same provider-side exposure as API latency, plus it now depends on the run's concurrency setting.

always_fail_regardless_of_threshold.description: Infrastructure correctness is not a tunable metric. Any non-zero value here invalidates the run's quality numbers, so it fails CI unconditionally.
